metadata.title: Aardbevingen (ROB)
metadata.abstract: The earthquake catalogue is a list of earthquakes from 1911 up to the present day with the following parameters: origin time (year, month, day, hour, minute, second), geographic coordinates of the hypocenter (latitude, longitude, focal depth), magnitude  maximum observed intensity, and the name of the locality.
metadata.label: Aardbevingen

metadata.title: Seismische zones
metadata.abstract: The Eurocode-8 seismic zoning map for Belgium was established by the Royal Observatory of Belgium for a return period of 475 years (equivalent to 10% probability of exceedance in a timespan of 50 years)
metadata.label: Seismische zones

metadata.title: Seismische meetstations
metadata.abstract:
The Belgian seismic network of the Royal Observatory of Belgium (ROB), with about 45 permanent stations, is mainly dedicated to the monitoring and the scientific study of the seismic activity in Belgium.
To complement the seismic network, the Belgian accelerometric network was installed early in the 2000ies to furnish reliable data when strong ground motions saturate traditional seismometers.
metadata.label: Seismische meetstations

metadata.title: GNSS Stations
metadata.abstract: The Royal Observatory of Belgium maintains several continuously observing GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) tracking stations in Belgium. The stations are also belonging to EUREF Permanent Network (EPN) used to maintain the ETRS89
metadata.label: GNSS meetstations
